source.title: Forest Ambience.wav
source.author: CHRISFOPFILMS
source.notes: 48 kHz stereo, 126 s, Masoala park, Madagascar: daytime rainforest, birds and insects at 3-11 kHz over a low murmur (wind or handling) and a burst of rumble at 70-75 s, all under 300 Hz, which the high-pass takes. A person talking through the first 18.7 s (bursts 20-36 dB over the forest at 300-1500 Hz) is left out: the loop starts at 20 s, as the author asked.
